sources.title: Kb-Bridge: Intelligent Knowledge Base Search & RAG Server
sources.snippet: Kb-Bridge is an intelligent Model Context Protocol (MCP) server engineered to significantly enhance knowledge base search and retrieval. It features an extensible architecture that supports multiple retrieval backend providers, ensuring flexibility across various data sources. The server offers a comprehensive suite of search methods, including hybrid, semantic, keyword, and full-text search ...

sources.title: Hands-On: `kb-bridge` for Context-Aware Knowledge Base Search
sources.snippet: In the previous posts (Part 1, Part 2, Part 3) I showed how we built the context-aware retriever. This post covers how to use kb-bridge, the Python package that exposes it. Modern RAG stacks are powerful but brittle—each new trick (GraphRAG, PageIndex, reranker cascades, etc.) helps some queries and hurts others. kb-bridge acts as an adapter instead of a replacement: it layers direct search ...
